name: guardrails-test-blocked-200
notes: Same sample as guardrails-test-200 but with the live store configured BlockPII=true: the probe must report the block the live config would apply, still without recording the sample or sending anything upstream. The Go test runs this fixture against a server built with that blocking config.
recorded_from: mock-upstream: no upstream exists for this endpoint — the handler runs the local guardrails scan only; recorded_response is the placeholder the harness schema requires, not a replayed upstream reply
